video_title: Coach Charles Lee Practice Media Availability | 10/18/26

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Charlotte Hornets' defensive progress during preseason
quotes.excerpt: I think that team is better than where we started. I think we made some progress.
quotes.quote: I think that team is better than where we started. I think we made some progress in a lot of areas, starting defensively. I think that now we have a lot of guys that are in the right positions, and then now that we're in those right positions, our technique is getting better. How are we just more effective, how are we more impactful, either on the ball or off the ball. And so I think that our guys did a really good job throughout preseason, defensive rebounding. We finished in that category really high. We finished in free throw attempt rate really high. So some of the fundamentals of how we play defense, I thought were pretty good and we got better again.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says the Hornets made progress during the preseason, specifically noting that the team finished high in defensive rebounding and free throw attempt rate.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on improving team execution and reducing turnovers
quotes.excerpt: No matter who is in the lineup, we have a certain way that we want to play.
quotes.quote: No matter who is in the lineup, we have a certain way that we want to play. And so I think that just from our running habit standpoint, some of our half-court execution, we got to clean that up. I think that if we do those things, we'll put ourselves in better position to create better shots for one another. I think that, you know, some of the turnovers will go down when we're not playing as slow, we're not playing in crowds, we don't have some of the casual turnovers.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says the Hornets need to clean up half court execution and reduce casual turnovers to create better shots for one another.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on status of injured Hornets players
quotes.excerpt: There's still no timeline on those guys. They're making really good progress.
quotes.quote: There's still no timeline on those guys. They're making really good progress. I think day by day, they've kind of stepped up what they've been able to do on the court, adding some level of contact to their workouts as well.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says there is still no timeline for injured Hornets players, though they are making progress and adding contact to their workouts.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee praises Christian Anderson's growth and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Love the growth that Christian made. I think just like the rest of our team.
quotes.quote: Love the growth that Christian made. I think just like the rest of our team, with every rep you got better and better. He finds his confidence. I think I love the the defensive impact he had. There are some possessions where he is picking up full court, refusing to be screened in pick and roll situations. I thought his hands were active, coming in and got a couple big rebounds. Like in Boston, he got fouled on one and hit the floor. Offensively, I think that he understands the pace at which we want to play and some of his outlets, he's getting up the court, playing early pick and roll. It's good to see the German connection in effect with him and Hannis and he's hitting them in the seam. I think he's finding where to shoot the ball and how to be more shot ready on the perimeter.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee is impressed with Christian Anderson's growth, highlighting his defensive impact, active hands, and ability to play early pick and roll.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the challenge of season opener against Brooklyn
quotes.excerpt: The intensity of the game goes up, how much longer those guys play during the game.
quotes.quote: Yeah, it definitely has a little bit of an impact. Like you said, it'll be different. The intensity of the game goes up, how much longer those guys play during the game. I know Brooklyn's probably added layers to their offense and their defense. So yeah, it helps a little bit, but overall, I think that we're going to have our hands full on the road versus a really good team.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee expects a challenge in the season opener against Brooklyn, noting that the Hornets will have their hands full on the road.
